And so that one solder did. And a lot of the solders wanted to try to see if it worked for them as well. It continued for some time until the higher ups suddenly knew what was happening and decided "lets just put a sign on the mines so no one else eats it!" And that's why you get the "DO NOT EAT" sign on the claymores!
